search_text: published ZDI-25-206 ZDI-CAN-25427 Amazon AWS CloudFormation Templates Uncontrolled Search Path Element Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-04-07 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Amazon'] ['AWS'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Amazon AWS. title: Amazon AWS CloudFormation Templates Uncontrolled Search Path Element Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Amazon AWS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the installation of AWS Simple Storage Service. When installed from the official GitHub repository, the installation attempts to load a non-existent cloud resource that is vulnerable to takeover. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code on systems dependent on the cloud resource.
